| description = Spawns in the first room of Kedge Keep, spot #1 on the map. Place holder is [[An impaler swordfish]] or [[a piercer swordfish]] on a 22 minute respawn. <--- THis PH information is not correct on Green as of 8/28/2020 (see below)

The [[an impaler swordfish]] and [[a piercer swordfish]] share a spawn and swim around the middle of the room, but are not a PH for the 'a fierce impaler', which spawns in the bottom of the room, with [[a lancer swordfish]] PH. There are three of them in the bottom, and at least two of them spawn very closely to each other, then patrol around the bottom, never swimming up into the middle/top of the room. I was able to charm a high-level spawn of [[an impaler swordfish]] and use it to keep the room down and kill the 'a fierce impaler' multiple times.
